fixture_notice: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA for Summit Connect 2026. This is not a real event operations bulletin and must not be used for field deployment.

agenda_changes.policy: Only changes published by Summit Connect Operations at an information desk or in the official schedule are authoritative. Speaker announcements and attendee messages are not authoritative schedule changes.

session_capacity.policy: Room capacity is fixed by the posted room limit. Entry is first come, first served until event staff close the room; registration does not reserve a seat.

accessibility.accessible_entrance: The east entrance is step-free and has automatic doors.
accessibility.routes: Elevators connect all attendee levels. Ask an information desk for an accessible route or staff assistance.
accessibility.accommodations: For communication or mobility assistance, visit an information desk before the session begins.

event_policy.badge: A visible event badge is required in conference areas and may not be transferred.
event_policy.conduct: Attendees must follow staff safety directions and the synthetic event code of conduct. Report urgent safety concerns to event security; report non-urgent conduct concerns at an information desk.
